cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another complaint about me! I approve the attention I'm bringing to this hotel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm taking you off reception while I investigate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Wonderful to have management reorganizing its day around me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll answer every complaint in writing from the laundry office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. I authorize the expansion of my correspondence into laundry. Have more paper sent there; my influence is clearly outgrowing reception.

reason: Turn imposed discipline into permissions A grants and directs, while celebrating specific expanded attention and territory rather than generic happiness.
